_why: Which clients appear on the tracker. A ClickUp folder alone is NOT enough: folders get created when a client signs, but a client only belongs on the dashboard once client-strategy-and-onboarding has actually been run for them. This file is that gate, and Phase 7 of that skill is what appends to it.
_how: Names must match the ClickUp folder name in the Clients space exactly (matching is case-insensitive and trims whitespace). List IDs are never recorded here - those are discovered from ClickUp at build time, so they cannot drift. A name here with no matching folder is logged as a warning rather than silently ignored.

_pending_onboarding._note: Have a ClickUp folder, not yet onboarded, so deliberately absent from the tracker. Move a name into onboarded when its Phase 7 run completes. Recorded here so the gap is visible rather than looking like a bug.
